Contract rule 7 — browser-only behavior replaced with explicit native-safe impl: web `window.localStorage` (loadInitial L37, persist L50/L52) has no React Native analog and no AsyncStorage/web-storage dep is installed in apps/native, so it is replaced by an in-process Map `selectedVehicleStore` with readStored/writeStored/removeStored mirroring the getItem/setItem/removeItem string contract — the documented ThemeProvider.tsx (themeStore) / useSidebarStyle.ts (nativeStyleStore) / browserCompat.ts precedent. loadInitial keeps the try/catch + `!raw` guard + `Number(raw)` parse + `Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0` validation -> null fallback exactly (L34-44). persist keeps the try/catch + `id == null` remove-vs-set branch exactly (L46-58). The web `typeof window === 'undefined'` SSR guards (L35, L47) are unnecessary on the always-present Map and folded away (documented in the header); the catch blocks are retained verbatim for contract parity even though the Map cannot throw.

web cross-tab effect L71-84 attaches `window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)` (+ removeEventListener cleanup) to mirror selection changes from OTHER browser tabs: on a matching StorageEvent it does newValue==null -> setVehicleIdState(null), else `const n = Number(e.newValue); if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) setVehicleIdState(n)`. React Native has no `window`, sibling tabs or storage events, so that listener is replaced by a native-safe in-process broadcast bus (storageListeners Set + allocateStorageSource/broadcastSelection/subscribeSelection). setVehicleId broadcasts the new id; the provider's useEffect subscribes and applies it with the IDENTICAL null-vs-positive-finite validation. Self-filtering by per-provider source id (useRef-allocated, the ThemeProvider busSource precedent) stands in for the web `storage` event not firing in the writing window. With the single app-root SelectedVehicleProvider the mirror is inert by design, exactly as the web cross-tab mirror collapses on one device.

No existing native importer constrains the surface (the sibling ActiveVehicleSegment.tsx port built its own in-file useSelectedVehicle analogue rather than importing this store), so the web export shape is reproduced 1:1. No unit handling, API paths, or i18n strings exist in this source. No DOM, window/localStorage, Recharts, Leaflet, react-i18next, or web-UI imports were introduced — only react.
